title: Nothing Is Watching
body:
A first mod of mine, a horror one in particular; adds the Hidden into your game. Completely hidden from sight, but dangerous. It spawns rarely and is almost impossible to see [because its invisible]. If you hear cave noises in places they shouldnt sound, _something is watching you._

It does 255+ damage and is invincible to everything.

Hitboxes are not reccomended to use if you want something scary.

**[ DISCLAIMER: This is my FIRST mod and it will be probably bad. I will make better, okay? ]**
